items.title: Odd Lots: Wall Street and the Post-Huang Nvidia Era (Podcast)
items.content: Nvidia's post-Jensen Huang era has just begun and there are so many open questions about the company's future. Who will the board choose to be Nvidia's next CEO? Will the government crack down on the chipmaker's business practices, particularly in Asia? And will Nvidia's uncertain position begin to spillover into the wider AI ecosystem, from the labs to data center providers? items.title: China Railways Set Record With 4.13 Billion Trips in 10 Months

items.title: Cruise Ship Capsizes After Tanker Collision in New Orleans
items.content: All passengers and crew members aboard a river cruise ship that capsized after a tanker collision in New Orleans on Friday were accounted for, with 32 people hospitalized but none critically injured, according to Mayor Helena Moreno. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Nvidia’s Board CEO Hunt, Stocks Finish Week Higher, Retail in Focus
items.content: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Franklin Templeton Institute’s Head Market Strategist Chris Galipeau, Pershing Square’s Founder and CEO Bill Ackman, London Business School Leadership Institute’s Founding Director Randall Peterson, Committee For A Responsible Federal Budget’s President Maya MacGuineas, Real Macro’s CEO and Founder Jeff Currie, Northwestern Mutual Wealth’s Chief Portfolio Manager of Equities Matt Stucky, National Academy of Engineering’s President Tse-Jae King Liu, Exemplar Luxury Group’s CEO Geoffroy van Raemdonck, Rent the Runway’s President and CEO Paige Thomas, Grammy Award Winning Singer and Hinote’s Co-Founder Carrie Underwood, Hinote’s CEO and Co-Founder Kerrigan Behrens. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Exemplar Luxury Group CEO on the Company’s Second Life
items.content: Geoffroy van Raemdonck said Exemplar Luxury Group is financially stronger after Saks emerged from bankruptcy. He emphasized reaching that goal through customer loyalty, full-price sales and profitable growth that supports reinvestment and strengthens relationships with brands. Geoffroy van Raemdonck speaks with Romaine Bostick on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)
